text:
incident-bot: Incident created: svc-inference-frontend - spike in 5xx rates, paging @Maya Patel (severity: page)
Maya Patel: picking up. seeing elevated 503/504 across eu/us regions, error budget dropping fast. grabbing logs.
Jon Chen: i'm on backup if you need help with dashboards/alerts.
Maya Patel: preliminary mitigation: scaled frontend pool and started a rolling restart of router-v2. shifting a small % of traffic to stable model pool.
Sam Ortiz: scale command executed at 14:04 UTC: `kubectl scale deploy/router-v2 --replicas=12 -n prod`
deploy-bot: deploy event: router-v2 rolling-restart triggered by Sam Ortiz at 2026-03-10T14:05Z
Maya Patel: initial root-cause smell: KV cache miss spike + backend ingress timeouts to model-serving. opening infra ticket.
Rachel Green: customer impact check: ~20% requests returned 5xx during peak window. a couple of larger customers reported timeouts in support.
Maya Patel: muted noisy alert for now: `rule_id=HTTP5xx_high` -> silence 30m to prevent alert storm (will keep tracking via dashboard).
Jon Chen: agree with mute short-term. we should NOT blindly lower sensitivity. plan a post-incident surgery to tune alerts and build dedicated retro dashboard.
Sam Ortiz: logs show redis RDB snapshot thrash leading to I/O spikes; filing INFRA-398 and pinging infra ops.
Maya Patel: mitigation step: disabled RDB snapshots temporarily on redis-primary, increased IO priority. monitoring impact.
Rachel Green: we should capture the golden signals for the retro: request rate, p95/p99 latency, error rate (5xx), and saturation (CPU, GPU queue, disk IO).
Jon Chen: drafting dashboard panels: request_rate, p95_latency, p99_latency, 5xx_rate, kv_cache_hit_ratio, backend_queue_depth, gpu_utilization (per-pool). add per-route breakdown and top-10 erroring tenants.
Maya Patel: also want annotation stream for incident-bot events and deploy-bot events so the timeline is obvious. drilldowns to traces per-route.
Jon Chen: sharing a minimal panel snippet for p95 latency (will expand in PR):
```json
{
  "type":"timeseries",
  "title":"frontend p95 latency",
  "targets":[{"expr":"histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))"}]
}
```
Rachel Green: that looks good. include a panel that shows "alerts fired" count and a mute timeline so we can correlate.
Sam Ortiz: proposed alert tuning: only fire `HTTP5xx_high` if sustained for >3m AND error rate >5% of requests AND backend timeout rate >1%. avoids noise on short blips.
Maya Patel: proposed rule (to be peer-reviewed in infra repo):
```yaml
alert: HTTP5xx_high
expr: |
  (
    sum(rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5.."}[3m]))
    / sum(rate(http_requests_total[3m]))
  ) > 0.05 and increase_over_time(backend_timeout_total[5m]) > 0
for: 3m
labels:
  severity: page
```
Jon Chen: I'll add a Grafana panel that plots the alert expression value (so ops can eyeball before it fires) and the current firing state.
Rachel Green: scheduling: 1-hour surgery tomorrow to finalize dashboard panels and alert rollouts. inviting @eng-sre and @eng-oncall.
Maya Patel: we also need a customer-facing timeline in the postmortem: impacted customers, start/end times, mitigation steps taken. I'll draft and attach to retro.
Sam Ortiz: follow-ups assigned: redis snapshot config, infra disk IO, and long-term cache sizing.
Maya Patel: post-incident checklist to track in the retro:
- create Grafana retros-dashboard with panels listed above and drilldowns
- ingest incident-bot/deploy-bot annotations
- implement alert rule changes and label severity appropriately
- add evals/canary tests to detect regressed p95 on rollout
- document runbook steps for cache/redis IO
Jon Chen: creating dashboard folder: `/dashboards/retros/incident-1834501234` and will PR JSON + alert-rule change to infra repo for review. tagging reviewers @eng-sre.
Rachel Green: mock screenshot link (placeholder): https://imgur.com/xyz - will replace with real dashboard when ready.
Maya Patel: criteria to close page: 5xx < 1% across all regions for 30m and infra ticket for redis acknowledged by infra team.
incident-bot: Incident state: resolved by Maya Patel at 2026-03-10T15:12Z — paging cleared.
Rachel Green: leaving thread open for surgery notes. i'll convert this into the retro doc after the dashboard PR lands.
Sam Ortiz: +1 on KV cache hit ratio panel and per-tenant top-10 error contributors.
Jon Chen: will include drilldown links to traces and a panel for backend queue depth by pool.
Maya Patel: final note: mitigation prevented major outage. action items for next sprint: infra followups + alert tuning + retros dashboard. thanks all :thumbsup:
